written_review: Viewed all six candidates on a dusk-navy ground at full size and at 120x160 (portrait) / 320x180 (landscape).
T1 (brim tip): charming wink-ready grin, but in the landscape the pupils look to the viewer's RIGHT, away from the title space; the portrait crops the raised elbow at the right canvas edge. Rejected.
T2 (nozzle): the hose runs off the left canvas edge in the portrait (breaks the 5 % inset, competes with the face) and the nozzle adds a second focal object at 120x160. Rejected.

T3 (salute): the largest, clearest face of the set; level warm brows with one cocked for mischief, both eyes with white area and one hard upper-left catch-light, open smile, hand drawn with a thumb and separated fingers; the salute frames the face instead of competing with it. In the landscape the eyes glance into the empty left. Chosen for BOTH aspects so the identity, pose and expression match.
Refinement t3_p_r2 (one edit, named defect): the right elbow was cut by the canvas edge; now the whole figure sits inside with margin (bbox 20..1500 x 101..1981 of 1536x2048).
Refinement t3_l_r2 (one edit, named defect): the landscape salute used one finger while the portrait used two; now a crisp two-finger salute matching the portrait.

Shield: generated BLANK brass; the "13" was lettered locally with tools/art/letter_shield.py (Alfa Slab One, ink #3B2313, brass shadow #B8862B) via thumbnail/source/prep_hero.py, the one treatment used on the rig shield and WILD badge (ART_HERO.md shield rule). It is part of the helmet emblem, not a title.

Final tiles at 120x160 / 320x180 with the title mock: the face (pig-skin blob 43 px / 64 px tall at the review sizes) and the 13 shield read immediately; the title sits in the quiet dusk-navy field above (3:4) / to the left (16:9) with no overlap; the lighter bay-door shapes backlight the helmet and add depth without competing. Grey-value check: the figure separates from the background at every edge.

Edges: foreground inspected on white and black (thumbnail/review/foreground_3_4_edges_white_black.png): clean dark-brown ink edge, no matte spill or glow halo, interior fully opaque (alpha >= 250 solidified to 255).

Residual notes: the 3:4 background keeps two soft dark shrub-like blobs at the far right edge beside the right pillar (low contrast, dominant vs dark tone); the 16:9 background has a darker pillar and floor line crossing the title area at low contrast. Neither is visible as a distraction at tile size. Agent review only, NOT human sign-off or platform approval.
